characters.name: Steing
characters.voice: Life-tax assessor, thin, fifty-one. Speaks the Dominion's Vrakht like a ledger clerk; uses the Hoh tone (patronizing) even on friends.

characters.name: Paskal
characters.voice: Conscript of nineteen from the far steppe, homesick, cheerful, plain soldier's speech.

characters.name: Mangel
characters.voice: Officer of twenty-five, straight-backed. Gna (polite) to her commander, Bef (command) to everyone else.

characters.name: Frecht
characters.voice: Commander, fifty-eight, tired and clever, speaks little and plainly.

characters.name: Kestim
characters.voice: Auditor of the capital, dry, polite, never raises her voice.

characters.name: Saellen
characters.voice: Ferrywoman of the Lyrshara; speaks market Vrakht to the soldiers, Aethel-Vael at home. Only her speech to the Dominion is Vrakht.

characters.name: soldier
characters.voice: Soldier of the Dominion garrison: speaks plain barracks Vrakht (Bef commands, short, rough); the Hoh and Droh tones to civilians.

characters.name: clerk
characters.voice: Clerk of the Ledger House: speaks Vrakht, dry and exact, Gna (polite) to the assessor.

characters.name: Dominion
characters.voice: Anyone of the Dominion (an officer, an official, an unnamed man or woman of its towns) speaks Vrakht.

characters.name: Mizuki
characters.voice: Does not speak the language of the valley.

characters.name: Tomáš
characters.voice: Has picked up the greetings and the numbers.

characters.name: Saellen
characters.voice: Ferrywoman of Silvakhor landing, forty-four, broad, sings under her breath, loses patience with fools and never with the hungry.

characters.name: Aelmoria
characters.voice: Hedge-witch of Kaelthal, sixty-eight, small, bent, very still; speaks softly and slowly.

characters.name: Lyrshara
characters.voice: Any of the river people the story does not name: speaks Aethel-Vael among themselves (soft, flowing); market Vrakht only to the Dominion.
